# veda.ng Documentation LLMs Index

Scoped index of documentation, research guides, and educational courses on veda.ng.

## Courses
- [Web3 Fundamentals](https://veda.ng/web3): Core blockchain and smart contract concepts
- [Agentic Web](https://veda.ng/agentic): Autonomous agents, MCP, and A2A protocols
- [MCP Development 101](https://veda.ng/mcp): Building Model Context Protocol servers
- [Vibe Coding](https://veda.ng/vibecoding): AI-assisted software development
- [Prompt Engineering 101](https://veda.ng/prompt): Prompting strategies for modern LLMs
- [AI Automation](https://veda.ng/automation): Agent workflows and integration patterns

## Tools & Libraries
- [Technical Glossary](https://veda.ng/glossary): 100+ plain-language definitions
- [AI Reports Library](https://veda.ng/ailib): 133,000+ AI papers sorted by citations
- [Web3 Reports Library](https://veda.ng/web3lib): 100,000+ Web3 papers sorted by citations
